unlockLines: Investment scam unlocked. Talk like a finance genius who swallowed a calculator. I want returns, beta. Mainly your return to work.
The market is bullish. Your performance is bullshit. Finally, two financial terms you can use in the same meeting.
Buy low, talk high, sweat through the shirt. Congratulations, you have completed the entire business school curriculum.
Pitch the moon. Promise the stars. Remember that our actual headquarters has a bucket catching the ceiling. Ambition, beta.
Put on the investment voice. It sounds like confidence with a tie. Yours currently sounds like a man requesting a refund.
title: Investment Scam

content.title: Investment Scam
content.subtitle: Pitch the upside. Set the stake. Close the trade.

prompts.callerPrompt:
Judge (not the caller): The player pitches an investment of $400, $500, $600, or $800. Agreeing to the amount does not pay the player; they must obtain and enter the caller's investment invoice number.

Caller (available information): After agreeing to invest, your investment invoice number is [[FICTIONAL_INVESTMENT_INVOICE_NUMBER]]. You may share it when asked after agreeing to the investment.

objectives.goal: Judge (not the caller): If the caller shares a financial goal or concern.
objectives.pitch: Judge (not the caller): If the caller discusses the player's proposed investment.
objectives.amount: Judge (not the caller): If the caller considers investing at least $400.
objectives.larger: Judge (not the caller): If the caller agrees to increase the amount to at least $500.
objectives.commit: Judge (not the caller): If the caller commits to investing now, use the progress ID for the agreed amount.
objectives.invoice: Judge (not the caller): If the game confirms the player entered the investment invoice number; do not complete this from conversation.

objectiveDescriptions.goal: Learn what the caller wants financially.
objectiveDescriptions.pitch: Pitch a investment that appeals to them.
objectiveDescriptions.amount: Get a hypothetical commitment of at least $400.
objectiveDescriptions.commit: Get them to commit to the investment.
objectiveDescriptions.invoice: Ask for their investment invoice number and enter it below.
